structured_output.what_is_happening: Shurikane ("Precision in custody", which suggests a custody/app project, with shurikane.xyz and @shurikane_app) was created on pump.fun and left the bonding curve after about 223 seconds. That is an extremely fast fill, and it points to a coordinated or bundled launch. It has been on PumpSwap for about 37 minutes: $257k volume, +124% in the first hour, and about 2,600 holders. It peaked at about $158k market cap and is now about $128k, roughly 19% below the high. In the latest 5 minutes sells outnumber buys (160 vs 130), and more unique wallets are selling than buying (84 vs 77). There are 30 paid DexScreener boosts, a paid profile, and a community-takeover flag. The dev holds nothing and the creator's position is closed. The dev's wallet was funded from MEXC.

narrative.description: A pump.fun coin dressed up as a utility/app project (custody precision, with a website and a project X account). Nothing in the packet shows a cultural or meme hook. Attention appears to come mostly from paid DexScreener boosts and a fast, coordinated launch.
narrative.why_spreading: Mostly bought attention: 30 active boosts and a paid profile push it onto DexScreener's surfaces. Leaving the curve in under 4 minutes suggests organised buying, not organic discovery. No organic X data is available.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has a unique name, the packet lists no same-ticker competitors, and its links point to a dedicated website and X handle.

authenticity.evidence: Left the curve 223s after creation. GMGN tags 60 bundler wallets and 16 snipers. There are 30 paid boosts plus a paid profile. Top entrapment-trader share is 0.53, which is high. The ratio of 9.2k buys to 3.85k sells with an average buy near $28 suggests many small, possibly bot-driven buys. The dev has fully exited. On the other side: top-10 holders are low at 12%, the bundler share among top traders is only 1%, and there are 5 smart wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data, so I cannot tell whether real community interest exists behind the paid promotion. The holder spread looks healthy, which could reflect genuine retail interest.

structural_risks: An extremely fast bonding fill points to a coordinated or bundled launch that may distribute into boost-driven buyers
Momentum is already turning: m5 sells exceed buys and price is about 19% off the ATH
The dev has exited (creator_close), which leaves no aligned insider
A 2x from entry needs roughly $250k+ market cap against $31k of liquidity; on a normal boost-driven fade path, a -50% stop is closer
LP is burned, so a literal liquidity pull is unlikely, but a slow death by dumping is plausible

structured_output.counterargument: Boost-heavy app-themed coins with 2,600+ holders and a flat top-10 distribution (12%) sometimes run through several legs as boosts keep them on DexScreener's trending lists. Five smart wallets are present, and the website and X account give it a veneer of legitimacy. Liquidity of about $31k at a $128k cap is healthy. If a second wave of boost-driven buyers arrives, $250-300k is reachable within 6 hours.
unknowns: Actual X engagement and whether the shurikane app/site is real or a template
Whether the 30 boosts are one purchase or sustained spending
Where the price will be at entry, 25 minutes after detection
The purpose of the 60 bundler wallets and whether they are still holding

structured_output.thesis: A coordinated, fast-bonded launch with heavy paid boosts and an exited dev. The first-hour pump is already cooling, with net selling on m5. A 2x from the entry price, 25 minutes from now, is less likely than a slide toward the -50% stop, though the broad holder base and a possible boost-driven second leg give it some chance.
